children: BRT Apartments entered into a fourth amendment to its Amended and Restated Loan Agreement with VNB New York, lowering borrowing costs and improving terms. The amendment reduces the interest margin to three-month term SOFR plus 210 bps (from +250 bps), cuts the interest rate floor to 5% (from 6%), and adjusts the cap rate used to value collateral to 6.25% (from 6.5%). As of September 17, 2026, the company can borrow $40 million under the facility. Management expects the revised pricing to reduce interest expense and enhance liquidity.
: Fourth amendment to amended revolving credit facility
: Lower borrowing costs and enhance liquidity
